# nowo Coworking Space

> The only coworking space in Widnau, Switzerland. 16 desks, 249 m², 24/7 access via the KleverKey app, own booking platform.

## Facts
- Address: Bahnhofstrasse 14, 9443 Widnau, Switzerland
- Contact: hello@nowo.space
- Booking: https://booking.nowo.space
- Access: 24/7 via KleverKey app, no key or badge needed
- Size: 249 m², 16 desks + 1 meeting room
- Getting there: 7–10 min walk from Heerbrugg station, parking available, minutes from the Austrian border
- Google rating: 5.0 (24 reviews)

## Plans (prices exclude VAT, CHF)
- Half-day pass: 20 CHF per half day
- Day pass: 35 CHF per day
- Flex Desk: 300 CHF/month — open desk, 24/7 access
- Fix Desk: 450 CHF/month — dedicated desk, lockable storage, mailing address
- Once a Week: 125 CHF/month — 1 fixed day/week
- Twice a Week: 210 CHF/month — 2 fixed days/week
- Off-peak (Randzeit): 179 CHF/month — from 5pm to end of day
- Weekend: 125 CHF/month — Saturday & Sunday
- Virtual Office: 100 CHF/month — business address in Widnau, mail handling, no desk

## Meeting room
- 31 m², 12 chairs, camera for video calls, 65" screen with Miracast, free coffee
- CHF 35/hour, CHF 30/hour from 4 hours, CHF 25/hour from 8 hours (excl. VAT)
- Booked by the hour via the member portal on booking.nowo.space

## FAQ
Q: How do I get in?
A: The KleverKey app on your phone unlocks the door any time, 24/7, no key or badge needed.

Q: How do I book a desk?
A: Through booking.nowo.space — pick a membership or day pass, book in a few clicks.

Q: Is there a minimum term?
A: Monthly membership: one month. Annual membership: one year. Day and half-day passes: no commitment.

Q: What's included?
A: Fast internet, height-adjustable desks, monitors, a printer, meeting-room use, coffee.

Q: Can I get a business address?
A: Yes, the Virtual Office (100 CHF/month) includes a domicile address in Widnau and mail handling.
